analysis:
MANAGE-ONLY MODE — 96% of equity deployed across 7 positions, zero headroom for new buys. Analysis focuses entirely on portfolio hygiene and thesis review.

MARKET BACKDROP: SPY is in confirmed uptrend (+1.7% vs SMA50, positive 20d slope), so the macro tailwind is supportive. However, that is no excuse to ignore the deeply troubling internal metrics: win rate 16.7%, profit factor 0.07x, Sortino -3.87. These numbers indicate the current approach is destroying risk-adjusted value, not preserving it. The core issue is adverse selection — losers are cut at ~4% but winners only captured ~2%, so the stop discipline is correct but the entry quality has been poor.

POSITION-BY-POSITION REVIEW:

• MCO (+7.11%, $13,121): Best performer. Moody's is a high-quality compounder with strong pricing power. Thesis intact. HOLD and consider trailing stop to lock in gains if momentum fades.

• AMP (+2.81%, $20,465): Working and ~20% of equity — near the concentration cap. Ameriprise is a quality wealth manager benefiting from rate environment. Thesis intact but size warrants monitoring. HOLD but do not add.

• ROP (+3.28%, $12,739): Roper Technologies — industrial software compounder, thesis intact. HOLD.

• AON (-0.91%, $12,236): Minor loss within normal noise for a quality insurance broker. Thesis intact. HOLD but confirm stop is properly placed (~4-6% below entry based on AON's ATR profile).

• IDXX (-0.33%, $14,474): Essentially flat. Idexx is a premium-moat vet diagnostics business. Loss is noise, not thesis break. HOLD but watch for deterioration below SMA50.

• SYK (-1.35%, $12,331): Minor loss. Stryker is a high-quality medical device compounder. No thesis break. HOLD.

• LMT (-3.73%, $12,302): Most concerning position. Lockheed Martin has been a persistent laggard — the prior LMT position was also exited via stop. At -3.73% from average entry of $580.85, current price $559.20. LMT's ATR is approximately 2.5-3% of price, meaning a 1.5-2x ATR stop from entry would be roughly $562-$552. We are already near/through that range. The defense budget environment remains uncertain and LMT is structurally heavier than peers. THESIS IS WEAKENING — this position is a candidate for exit on any further weakness or if $550 breaks on a closing basis.

OVER-CONCENTRATION CONCERN: 7 positions violates the stated 3-5 target. With 4 positions roughly flat or losing and only 3 in the green, the portfolio is running too many mediocre ideas simultaneously — exactly what the strategy warns against. When LMT or any other position hits its stop, do NOT replace it with a new name until headroom permits a properly-sized, high-conviction entry.

ACTION: No trades proposed this cycle. Enforce existing stops. Let winners run. Exit LMT at market open if $550 is violated on a closing basis — do not override the stop in hopes of a recovery. Reducing to 5-6 positions naturally as stops are hit will restore the capacity to act decisively when a truly asymmetric setup emerges.
